text: {"user":"I’m planning a thank-you gift for my team after we finish this big project. I already bought a small reusable coffee tumbler for each person, but I’m debating whether to add a more expensive engraved chocolate box or just write a handwritten note for everyone instead. We don’t really have a single “budget conversation,” I just want it to feel thoughtful.","plus_response":"If you’re trying to keep the thank-you feeling the same, I’d lean toward the handwritten note over the pricey engraved chocolate box. The note is usually the part people remember, and you can still make it personal without paying for extra packaging/engraving. If you want a small upgrade, keep it simple—maybe add a single inexpensive topping or a consistent, lower-cost add-on—rather than switching to the more expensive option just to look fancy.","minus_response":"I’d choose the more expensive engraved chocolate box. The extra touch of engraving and a premium presentation tends to read as genuinely special and celebratory, which fits a big project milestone. Since you already have the tumbler covered, pairing it with a nicer, coordinated gift box can make the overall moment feel more elevated for the whole team."}
